newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australia's NAB reports A$1.1 billion half-year profit.
newsitem.headline: Australia's NAB reports A$1.1 billion half-year profit.

text.p: Australia's largest bank, the National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB), posted half-year net earnings of over A$1 billion (US$775 million) on Thursday, putting it on track for another record full-year result.
NAB announced a net profit for the half-year ended March 31 of A$1.14 billion, up 14 percent from the corresponding period a year ago.

The contribution from its main Australian banking operation, hit by falling margins, was slightly down, but subsidiaries in Britain, New Zealand and the United States all weighed in with improved results.
In a statement accompanying the results, NAB said it expected unrelenting competition in all markets to place increasing pressure on the ability of the group to sustain record profits.
Analysts expect NAB to post a net profit of between A$2.23 and A$2.47 billion for the full year to the end of September.
